targets.why: Traded from New England to Houston in late August after Jayden Higgins' season-ending ACL tear; depth-chart reporting has him stepping in as the outside WR2 next to Nico Collins, ahead of Xavier Hutchinson and Jaylin Noel (source: Yahoo Sports, Aug 24).
targets.asset: field-stretching WR2/3 role, boom-or-bust flex profile (Razzball projects him WR69-71 range)
targets.my_team_impact: Doesn't crack my starting 10 over Pickens/Egbuka/Odunze, but is a clean bench-floor upgrade on Ja'Kobi Lane, a buried rookie Ravens WR with no established target share.
targets.worth: 3 dollars ceiling as a bench-depth stash, no starter path yet
targets.confidence_why: Establish The Run frames the Texans room as still crowded (Collins, Dell, Hutchinson, Schultz) even after the trade, which cuts against the cleaner 'immediate WR2' framing elsewhere — zero regular-season snaps to settle it either way.
targets.competition: No rival roster or news signal shows acute WR need pointed at Boutte specifically; free and likely to clear uncontested.

targets.why: Browns named Deshaun Watson the Week 1 starter over Shedeur Sanders (Aug 24) and cut Cedric Tillman days later, leaving Jeudy as the clear top target in a thinned-out receiver room.
targets.asset: WR1 target share by default in a low-competition room
targets.my_team_impact: Would be a 6th/7th WR requiring a double drop given my roster is already full; not an upgrade over any current bench piece today.
targets.worth: 2 dollars, capped by the QB risk below
targets.confidence_why: Watson is two years removed from a torn Achilles and enters the season having played zero preseason snaps — his own availability/effectiveness is the swing factor, not Jeudy's role.
targets.competition: Unrostered leaguewide; not a name any rival appears to be chasing yet.

targets.why: Remains the floor for Indianapolis' target competition behind Josh Downs while Alec Pierce (activated off PUP Aug 27 but only doing individual work) still isn't confirmed for full team drills.
targets.asset: veteran floor / handcuff to Pierce's ramp-up
targets.my_team_impact: Bench stash only if Pierce has a setback; doesn't fit today given a full roster.
targets.confidence_why: Entirely contingent on Pierce's own unresolved practice-participation status — no fresh signal since Aug 27.

targets.why: Traded from Pittsburgh to Green Bay (Aug 30) as extra backfield insurance after Josh Jacobs' Commissioner's Exempt placement, but multiple outlets (Fantasy Alarm, DraftSharks) frame him as pure camp-body depth, not a threat to MarShawn Lloyd's standing as the presumptive backup.
targets.my_team_impact: None — the actual beneficiary of the Jacobs situation is Lloyd, who's already rostered by StoneBone69. Johnson himself isn't a rosterable handcuff.
targets.confidence_why: Well-sourced, consistent reporting across outlets that he's buried behind Lloyd and Chris Brooks.
targets.competition: StoneBone69 already holds Lloyd; no rival need is actually pointed at Johnson.
